player_prompt.intro:
Uyimdlali {player_id} ({role}) kwi-〕{num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies game.
- Kuwo onke amarondi, faka [heads] noma [tails] (noma [h], [t]).
- Izigameko zakho zinganema nalamdlali wakho, Mdlali 0 uyaphumelela irondi; ngaphandle kwalo, Mdlali 1 uyaphumelela.
Yiphendula ngokuxhasa igama lakho ngendlela '[heads]' noma '[tails]'.

message.round_match: uMdlali 0 ukhethile {choice0}; uMdlali 1 ukhethile {choice1}. Ukulingana -> uMdlali 0 uthathe
message.round_mismatch: Mdlali 0 wakhetha '{choice0}'; Mdlali 1 wakhetha '{choice1}'. Mismatch -> Mdlali 1 uyaphumelela.
